title: Tideworks Yard
rules: Cross on the permanent northern bridge, the low-tide southern causeway, or real pontoon sections.
The tide cycles low/rising/high/falling, three ticks each. The causeway is safe only at low tide.
Current pulses at t=6,12,... move an unanchored component one row south at phase 2 or north at phase 0.
An anchor anywhere in a connected lashed raft holds the whole raft. Releasing it can move another worker and cargo.
Lift only an isolated unanchored section without a worker or crate aboard. Place it east or west into a free channel cell.
Lashing makes real symmetric connections; unlash to separate a section. Only its owner changes private/shared access.
Workers have one carrying slot for a crate or pontoon. Crate ownership and identity survive handoffs and raft motion.
Unsupported workers or sunk required crates end the episode naturally. Actions and scene use the same native state.

linked_now: Per-section lash/unlash command this step. Flattened row-major.
delivered_now: Per-owner crate delivery count this step. Flattened row-major.
